image_description: The image displays two traffic light units suspended from overhead wires against a cloudy sky and a modern building facade. The primary subject is the left traffic light, which is illuminated red at the top. It features a vertical black housing with three circular lenses, each equipped with a visor/hood. The right traffic light is seen from a side/rear angle, showing its yellow/tan housing and mounting arm. Power lines crisscross the upper portion of the frame.

artifact_observations.location: Top mounting bracket of left traffic light
